hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.java) svc_dir="${f%/src/*}"; if [ -f "$svc_dir/gradlew" ]; then (cd "$svc_dir" && ./gradlew spotlessApply -PspotlessIdeHook="$f" --console=plain -q); fi ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */config-repo/*|*/application*.yml|*/application*.yaml|*/application*.properties|*.env|*.env.*|*[Ss]ecret*|*[Cc]redentials*) jq -n --arg reason "설정/민감 정보 파일 수정 - 확인이 필요합니다: $f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}' ;; esac

services=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -oE '^(order-service|product-service|api-gateway|discovery-service|config-service)' | sort -u); fail=""; for svc in $services; do if [ -f "$svc/gradlew" ]; then (cd "$svc" && ./gradlew test --console=plain -q) || fail="$fail $svc"; fi; done; if [ -n "$fail" ]; then jq -n --arg reason "빌드/테스트 실패:$fail — 문제를 수정한 뒤 다시 커밋하세요" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; fi
